name: Big Top T's / Texas Apparel & Big Tees
old_description: We custom make all of our orders. If you can describe it, We CAN make it.
about:
Texas Apparel & Big Tees, doing business as Big Top T's, operates from Irving, Texas. The company focuses on custom-made apparel with a specialization in extended sizes up to 10XLT. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in the available information.

The company produces a range of garments including T-shirts, tops, sweatpants, and sweatshirts. All orders are custom manufactured in the United States, with the company stating it can produce any design a customer describes. No facility size, employee count, or production volumes are disclosed.

The business serves both individual consumers and organizations seeking custom larger-size apparel. The website presents a retail-style storefront with pricing, size measurements, and color selections, suggesting direct-to-consumer sales alongside potential wholesale or bulk orders. The Irving location operates Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., and offers customer support via phone and email.

Texas Apparel & Big Tees emphasizes its "Custom Made in the USA" commitment and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. The company positions its ability to custom-make any described item as a key differentiator, aiming to provide quality and durability without compromise.
